results.name: capabilities list ten read-only products and mark Forms/Slides selectable
an unknown product is rejected locally
a missing product scope fails before any request is made
a disconnected account fails before any request is made
Gmail reads metadata only, caps detail fetches and reports truncation
Tasks reads bounded lists and completed tasks are marked, not changed
Forms requires a locally selected, validated document
Slides requires a locally selected presentation and reads its outline
document selection is capped, deduplicated, persistent and removable
Contacts reads the account connections with bounded fields
Calendar reads primary events from the start of today
Picker reads Drive metadata only, with no content download
Chat lists spaces without requesting message history
Classroom lists active courses only
a 401 marks reauthorization and returns GOOGLE_REAUTH_REQUIRED
a 403 returns GOOGLE_SCOPE_MISSING and does not mark reauthorization
a 429 returns GOOGLE_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After seconds
a 500 returns a retryable GOOGLE_API_UNAVAILABLE
an oversized response is rejected before parsing
a hung request is aborted as GOOGLE_TIMEOUT
item output is capped at the configured maximum for every list reader
endpoint overrides cannot leave the reviewed origins
disconnect purges Forms and Slides local selections
document URL parsers accept only docs.google.com /d/ URLs
error mapping distinguishes quota from permission
renderer, preload and shared contracts carry no token material
